name: Citizenship by Descent (born abroad to a Dominican-citizen parent)

qualifying_event.description: A person born outside Dominica acquires Dominican citizenship if, at the date of birth, their father or mother was a citizen of Dominica (Constitution, Section 99).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Parent's proof of Dominican citizenship at the time of the applicant's birth; applicant's birth certificate.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires that at least one parent was a Dominican citizen at the time of the applicant's birth.

evidence_required.document: Parent's proof of Dominican citizenship at time of applicant's birth

sources.title: UN Women Constitutions Database -- Constitution of the Commonwealth of Dominica, Section 99 (citizenship by descent)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Dominica's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT for the same reason as dm_naturalisation: the substance is a genuine, specific constitutional provision (Section 99), but the only source located reproducing it in this pass is an intergovernmental (UN Women) host, not a Dominica government domain -- the cbiu.gov.dm-hosted Citizenship Act PDF was not machine-readable, and no dominica.gov.dm-hosted copy of the Constitution was located. Revisit and upgrade to 'published' if a tier-1-hosted copy is found. Kept as its own route (category 'ancestry') rather than folded into dm_naturalisation since it is a genuinely distinct, automatic legal ground with no residence test, unlike naturalisation's 7-year test.
